description: TADAS (Turkish Accelerometric Database and Analysis System) is a hazard data portal run by Disaster and Emergency Management Presidency of Türkiye (AFAD). A news item on the launch of the system describes a database of about 83 thousand three-component waveforms from 795 active and 175 passive stations for 8,372 earthquakes up to magnitude 7.6 between 1976 and 2020, with an analysis module for strong-motion records. Coverage: Türkiye and neighbouring seismic regions. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated; not read. Caveats: the page shows only a loading message, so the holdings, access rules, formats and licence come from a news item dated 2020 and are unverified; registration may be needed for waveform download. It can support ground-motion inputs for seismic vulnerability studies of Turkish infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: only the page title and meta description came back (the page is drawn by script); statements come from those and from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
